configure.inputModeInfo:
Voice: you and the AI exchange entirely out loud throughout the conversation.

Hybrid: you click on the proposed choices to answer and only speak for the rest of the experience. Ideal in noisy environments.

Visual: no voice at all. You read the questions and click your answers. Formulas are generated directly.
